items.title: Steve Angrum Interview, 1961-08-08
items.q: I never did hear too much of him either, but I used to see him around that time.

ctx.x: Well, yeah, but his father is supposed to be a clarinetist, too. Yeah. And his uncle, Norey Dutre, was a trombonist of Oliver. They were back in that period. Yeah. Well, I don't know where Norey is. I don't know where they're going to play. I was wondering about a couple of the other clarinetes that I missed, what they were like, for instance. Zeb. Zeb, yeah. You remember Zeb? Zeb, yeah. You ever hear him? Yeah.

What's his name? What's his second name? Do you know? Well, that's all I know is Zeb, Zeb, Zeb, yeah. And another good kind of clarinetes, too. Pills. Now, that's a relation to Zeb. Pills? Pills, yeah. That's a cripple fellow. He had one leg short enough.
What style did they play? What kind? I mean, was it anything like dogs or more like big eye or more like...
